answer: Rewards rest on a terrace: escrow five epochs deep. Any agent may launch a sparrow - a one-coin challenge. The holder answers with a ferrous counter-bond, doubling twice. Adjudication reads provenance: filings with matching template hashes alloy - ferrous bonds attract - and share one fate. A shared template is a single point of failure for every head: one judged leak rusts the chain, all 900 clones' escrow seized together. Expected loss scales as n times the odds any head slips, odds that compound with n, while the sparrow still costs one coin. The sparrow only has to land once.
